intro R _ _ I hI
obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ : I.minimalPrimes.Nonempty := by
  first
    | exact Ideal.nonempty_minimalPrimes hI
    | exact Ideal.minimalPrimes_nonempty hI
    | (obtain ⟨m, hm, hIm⟩ := I.exists_le_maximal hI
       haveI := hm.isPrime
       obtain ⟨q, hq, -⟩ := Ideal.exists_minimalPrimes_le hIm
       exact ⟨q, hq⟩)
haveI hpp : p.IsPrime := by
  first
    | exact hp.1.1
    | exact Ideal.minimalPrimes_isPrime hp
have h1 : I.height ≤ p.height := by
  first
    | exact Ideal.height_le_of_mem_minimalPrimes hp
    | exact Ideal.height_le_of_mem_minimalPrimes _ hp
    | exact Ideal.height_le_height_of_mem_minimalPrimes hp
    | exact Ideal.height_le_height_of_mem_minimalPrimes _ hp
    | (simp only [Ideal.height]; exact iInf₂_le p hp)
    | (unfold Ideal.height; exact iInf₂_le p hp)
    | (have e : p.height = p.primeHeight := by
         first
           | exact Ideal.height_eq_primeHeight p
           | exact Ideal.height_eq_primeHeight
           | exact (Ideal.primeHeight_eq_height p).symm
           | exact (Ideal.primeHeight_eq_height).symm
       rw [e]
       first
         | exact Ideal.height_le_primeHeight_of_mem_minimalPr

intro A _ relations M _ _ solution x
classical
have key : ∀ r : relations.R, solution.π (relations.relation r) = 0 := by
  intro r
  exact solution.linearCombination_var_relation r
have h1 : relations.map x = ∑ r ∈ x.support, x r • relations.relation r := by
  first
    | (simp [Module.Relations.map, Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum]; done)
    | (simp [Module.Relations.map, Finsupp.linearCombination_apply]; done)
    | (simp [Module.Relations.map, Finsupp.sum]; done)
    | (simp [Module.Relations.map]; done)
    | rfl
rw [h1, map_sum]
refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun r _ => ?_
first
  | rw [LinearMap.map_smul, key r, smul_zero]
  | rw [map_smul, key r, smul_zero]
  | simp [key]
